rules.statement: A person who possesses a land with a secret intention that he would be able to claim prescription at the end of ten years is not entitled to claim prescription under Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: If a person, who claims prescription in terms of Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance, possesses the property with a secret intention his possession cannot be considered as an adverse possession and as such he is not entitled to succeed in a claim of prescription.
